card.name: Leading digit of a dose before mg
card.fires_on: The first digit (often 3 or 4) or the space just before a multi-digit dose number, where the unit mg is expected next. Seen in dose ranges and tablet strengths for antidepressant and similar drugs.

modes.label: First digit of a dose
modes.description: A leading digit such as 3 or 4 that starts a dose number like 300 or 360, followed by mg.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: The blank just before a dose figure in a dosing table or taper instruction.
modes.example: Oral<< >>200 mg Once daily Not App

card.writes: It promotes the unit mg (and its Chinese equivalent) and suppresses therapy and treatment words, so a dose unit is expected next.
card.plain: It fires on the start of a dose number, when the unit mg is about to come next.
